notes.note: #2998 part 2a security fix round: install-trust migration state now also lives in the installation journal (new package_plugin_trust_migration table and optional journal methods), the first attempt freezes the pre-d1 set and retries unreadable plugins, mismatches are unrecorded, the install transaction and raw registry agent copy run the migration at entry, a reinstall after uninstall is capped at its own provenance, and records invalidated outside the installer read as stale. Scanned this document for installation-journal, catalog, registry-install, transaction and on-disk-state claims; none is contradicted (grants, consent, renderer selection and success responses are unchanged).
